content: Ne vurya̱jaryeta ti̱ nijya̱nvay cabyimusiy

Ratyeryi̱veda, jiryatiy vu̱tyuva̱chu simu Jesucrístu vandamu, ne vurya̱jaryetasarani̱ ti̱ nijya̱mi̱ Ju̱denu siityari̱jadamuju̱, ne vinu jiryatiy savicha jaryi tarati̱, dantyamu̱y ne vurya̱rrachuni̱ jiryatiy jantyuyani̱ní̱.

Dañuma saryi jay vu̱yntye̱ryanijyovimu ti̱qui vanu samijetyi̱, órutera jana̱jatuti̱ risa̱ju̱ni̱, nu̱ntiy dañuma sa̱jay ta̱rijepyota, jantyuyani̱, varityi vu̱jeryetani̱ samijetyi̱ vurya̱tidye jtay siva: “Ya̱jay, ya̱ma̱sa samirya ma̱sajoncha”; nu̱ ji̱ta, jantyuyani̱, vu̱ryi jtay dyetya siva: “Jasiy ya̱raniy,” varimyata vu̱ryi jtay siva: “Mitya ya̱ma̱sa mucomu,” vu̱jeryeta varivyu̱y, nu̱tyichitya vurye̱charu̱y variy samivye. Vu̱ñi̱cha variy taji jachipiya̱jadatavay.

Jirya̱tuva̱chu rañe̱cho̱, ratyeryi̱veda va̱tasavay. ¿Ne jiryedyetyaru̱dye jiryatiy sajaryeta̱da Ju̱denu riy jantyuyadavay rirya̱tidye vichaniy si̱tenu tuva̱chuvay variryi, rirya̱tidye jmutya̱ varirya jiyaru̱rya sansu̱jyomu rusa̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ jiryatiy sava̱tavadyeryi?
Jirye ji̱ta javiryu̱tya daryi jantyuyadavadye. Jiryi̱tañi̱viy tarati̱ni̱ ramutiy sivaatyaniy mitya jirye, satiichiy simuju̱ cadnadu variy jirye.
Jaryi tarati̱ ji̱ta javityiye̱rya Ju̱denu jtya ramutiy jiryi̱tyu̱y varidye.
Vu̱tyi jto̱taniy ji̱tara Vu̱yntyityu̱ niquejada, darya nu̱chara ni̱day:

content.text: “Vurya̱ntya va̱tani̱ vu̱ryeryenu nijya̱mi̱ nu̱tyu vu̱vya̱ta daryantivyu̱y,”

content: vuryivaay samirya variy.
Vu̱tyi jaryeta ti̱, vu̱jyuuchuvay variy, Ju̱denu niquejada jtay darya.
Ne jiryi̱nu̱y, ni̱tiy ne jto̱taniy ti̱ta̱ju̱ra Ju̱denu niquejada, sa̱jiyasay variy ratayu.
Tapi ni̱tiy niquejada:
saniquejadantiy:
Dañumamu̱y ne vu̱ryupi ti̱ vaturu̱jsa̱, vu̱ryityi jvay ti̱, vurya̱rupanu varirya Ju̱denu niquejada.
Ramuni̱tiy vurya̱nique samirya, vurye̱cha samivye variy, ramutiy sa̱saranu Ju̱denu variy jiñiquejadata vu̱y, jiryatiy raratyanu juuchuvedajisivyu̱y.
Ni̱timyu̱ ne jantyutya ti̱, Ju̱denu ra̱chaniy sa̱ntyutyi̱sa̱damu tarayu. Jantyutya̱da ji̱ta jaryinra ramusiy tu̱chuta̱da murichenutadeda.
Vurya̱dityanura vu̱tyuva̱choda vu̱vyichadedamu
Ratyeryi̱veda, ¿Ta̱ra vu̱ryiryi rata jiryatiy vu̱ñi jtay si̱tenu jachipiya̱vavyu̱y, ne vuryivaay nta tara ramusiy? ¿Ra̱ni̱viy jantyutya vinu vu̱jechipiya̱jada vu̱y?

Saryityi rupiñe̱ya̱ sidyavu̱ ti̱qui vu̱tyeryi̱, varimyata vuryi̱tyamutu, ne jmyicharati̱ daryaju̱ni̱, vuryi̱tatyi variy siva: “Ye̱jiya jidyirya samiryamu, ya̱vano̱nu sujajyuuta ji, ya̱potyaniy ji̱ta varintyi ji” tama̱ vu̱ñi sa̱y tarani̱, tama̱, tama̱ samirya rani̱cha daryamusiy.
Netimyu̱ ne vuryivaay samiryara vu̱jechipiya̱jada si̱tenu, ra̱rupanuma̱ varidyerya si̱tenu vu̱tyuva̱choda day.

Ti̱ni̱ dyetya jtadye: “Ji si̱tenu tuva̱chura, ray ji̱ta jvaay si̱tenu samiy. Ya̱dityanu si̱tenu jijechipiya̱jada yivaayadasa̱ racyu̱, samiryavidye rani̱cha, ray ji̱ta ra̱dityanu rivaayadamusiy jíírya si̱tenu rajechipiya̱jada.”
Jijechipiya̱ dyetya: “Vinu ti̱qui savichasara Ju̱denu.” Jivyichaniy samirya jiryatiy tuva̱chura ji. Bayantuveda jarye tuva̱chu simu Ju̱denu, samuchutye variy jichuvu̱yadamu.
Ne jidyetyaru̱y jidyetyi̱sa̱damu, tama̱ samirya rani̱cha tuva̱choda, tama̱, netimyu̱ ne vuryivaay samiy risa̱ju̱ra tara.
Daryatiy vu̱myunatyi̱ Avurá̱bay jnutatya̱dani̱ jidyenu Isácubay siva Ju̱denu, su̱tedamu, Ju̱denu diyada variy siityeera siva.
Ne jiryi̱nu̱y, satuva̱choda jmu̱tya̱da sivaayadaju̱yu, daryamusiy ji̱ta sivaayadamusiy yito̱tanirya jityuva̱choda simu Ju̱denu.
Daryamusiy rito̱tadeda Ju̱denu niquejada jiryatiy sivaañu̱yada Avurá̱barya, darya jtachara:

content.text: “Satuva̱choda Avurá̱bay simu Ju̱denu, su̱mutya̱jada variñi̱, jiryatiy vase vichara sadiya daryaju̱ni̱, Ju̱denu jteda variy jijemyicyuni̱.”

content: ¿Jiryeñi jnu̱mya̱viy? Su̱mutya̱sara Ju̱denuni̱ vanu nu̱tyu vase jvaarya, ne vinu satuva̱chodamu, netiy vinu sivaayadiva jarye.

Darya nanuvichanu̱yada ta̱riy cadnatoda Raábijyu̱y jtyatanu̱be, su̱mutya̱jada Ju̱denu nadivaayadamusiyu, jiryatiy nani̱mutya̱jada jiryorimyu nada jpa̱sanu̱jyu̱y, jnu̱yasanu̱jyu̱y daryaju̱ nada, nani̱pa̱jada ji̱ta vani̱rade jadchiy tanú̱va nada, sañuma ju̱riy ju̱ri̱ nada, ramuni̱tiy nani̱pa̱jada tanú̱va nada.
Ni̱tiy jtay yitu̱yadamu jityuva̱chu simu Ju̱denu ¿va̱ taraju̱ rani̱cha cay? Nu̱tyunuma savu̱ rani̱cha jnutusa̱.
